jobs.title: Program Lead, Global Rider Experience
jobs.description:
About the Team  
  
The Global Rider team in Community Operations (CommOps) owns the end-to-end support experience for Uber Mobility riders worldwide. Our mission is simple: **fix the upstream causes of rider defects in the product before support is needed, and make resolution fast, fair and seamless when a defect does occur.** Our North Star is the **Rider Defect Rate.**  
  
In 2027, our core focus will be to:  

* Eliminate rider defects, in particular charge riders transparently and accurately for their experience
* Make live chat the default modality following GenAI to enable fast resolution for all customer
* Create clear, trusted outcomes and match customer value and needs to the right level of support

  
About the Role  
  
You will report to the Global Rider Persona Lead. Most team members own a policy area end to end such as cancellations, fare disputes, driver feedback or lost item. **This role is different: you will own a portfolio of transversal programs that cut across those policies.** These are problems no single policy owner can solve alone, and solving them consistently across policies has an outsized effect on rider trust, resolution quality and cost.  
  
You will work with Tech (Customer Obsession and core product teams),CommOps functional teams (GDX, GSO, Central CommOps, PIR, Risk, Finance, CRM, Content, L&D) and regional CommOps POCs to turn several separate policy initiatives into one coherent global program each.  
  
What You'll Do  

* **Lead a portfolio of transversal programs** that cut across rider policies: define the scope, success metrics, governance and roadmap of each, and agree clear decision rights with policy owners, Product and Ops partners. The portfolio is expected to evolve, with new cross-policy topics added as opportunities emerge. Initiatives could include for example:
  + **GenAI resolution (Lumen and Nova):** driving cross-policy improvements to AI-led resolution, for example raising CSAT on Nova FAQ answers, improving intent accuracy and making sure riders are routed to the right resolution path.
  + **Agent enablement in a post-automation world:** shaping how human agents are equipped where automation stops, including: agent tooling, the right agent profile and KPIs (in particular on quality) with our BPO partners.
  + **Driver behavior and top defect creators (Driver Induced Rider Support):** bringing together education, feedback and proactive decisioning efforts aimed at the small group of drivers who generate a large share of defects
  + **Refunds, appeasements and goodwill frameworks:** building a consistent way to recover the rider experience across policies, and monitoring and optimizing spend with Finance and Risk.
* **Find key experience gaps** across policies, along with emerging trends and drivers of customer satisfaction, and use them to shape strategy and roadmap decisions.
* **Own tracking, reporting and performance insights** for your programs (defect rate, resolution rate, iCSAT, spend, agent KPIs) so that prioritization is driven by data.
* **Build the customer intelligence engine** for transversal topics: turn contact signals, sentiment and defect data into sized, prioritized cases that upstream product and ops teams act on.
* **Manage stakeholder alignment** across engineering, data science, product, regional operations, Risk, Finance and other support teams to unblock dependencies and protect execution quality.
* **Partner with the Global Driver team** to keep things fair on both sides and assess how changes affect drivers.

  
Basic Qualifications  

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in customer experience operations, product operations, strategy or program management at tech or marketplace scale.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in business administration, finance, engineering or a related field.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional programs that span several teams, policies or business lines without direct authority.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Science Program Management
jobs.description:
Biohub is the first large-scale initiative bringing frontier AI models, massive compute, and frontier experimental capabilities under one roof. We're building a general-purpose system to accelerate scientific discovery, integrating frontier AI models, biological foundation models, and lab capabilities, with the ultimate goal of curing disease. Our technology powers scientists around the world, translating AI capabilities into tools that accelerate research everywhere.

**The Team**
------------

Biohub is the first large-scale initiative bringing frontier AI models, massive compute, and frontier experimental capabilities under one roof. We're building a general-purpose system to accelerate scientific discovery, integrating frontier AI models, biological foundation models, and lab capabilities, with the ultimate goal of curing disease. Our technology powers scientists around the world, translating AI capabilities into tools that accelerate research everywhere.

The Science Program Management team turns that strategy into coordinated execution by steering our most complex, cross-functional programs. We enable impactful, efficient, and scalable program delivery across the Biohub ecosystem, fostering strategic alignment and organizational connectivity to maximize scientific and technical impact.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Biohub is seeking an experienced Program Manager (PM) to join Science Program Management and own a portfolio of the organization's cross-cutting scientific programs. Each program sits at a different stage of maturity—from strategic planning to proof-of-concept to scaled multi-workstream efforts. The person in this role will be among the first to translate strategic decisions into working programs.

This is ideal for a PM who takes pride in disciplined, transparent execution and brings a builder's mindset to process design, from meeting cadence to cross-team dependency tracking to leadership reporting. You'll report to the Director of Science Program Management and work closely with technical and scientific leads across the organization in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where your contributions directly enable the team's scientific and technical output.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own day-to-day program management for a portfolio of Biohub's highest-priority cross-cutting programs sourced from Biohub's strategic planning processes—partnering closely with the scientific and technical leads who own each program's direction—tailoring your approach to each one's stage of maturity
* Take newly prioritized initiatives from strategy into execution: scope the work, build the plan, and stand up the operating structure
* Serve as the coordinating point for efforts that span multiple teams and functions
* Design and run cross-workstream tracking systems that surface shared dependencies across programs, and operate leadership reporting and escalation paths for decisions and deep-dives that need senior attention
* Partner closely with scientific and technical leads to identify risks and blockers early, and adapt your process as priorities shift
* Establish priorities by evaluating value and risk tradeoffs, and develop metrics for near-term delivery and long-term program success
* Build governance and decision-making frameworks and mentor other project and program managers, contributing to our shared playbook and toolset

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 8+ years of program or project management experience, including substantial time supporting scientific, technical, or research-driven organizations
* Direct experience working in a scientific or technical setting—you are comfortable in the room with researchers and can engage credibly with the substance of the work
* Proven track record of building program structure and process from scratch in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Experience managing cross-functional dependencies and stakeholder communication across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and shifting priorities, without waiting for a fixed playbook
* Strong written and oral communication skills, including experience translating complex technical or scientific discussions into clear operational plans
* Demonstrated ability to build trust quickly with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners
* Fluency in project management and tracking tools (e.g., Airtable, Notion, Smartsheet or similar) to support planning, dependency tracking, and reporting

**Compensation**
----------------

The Redwood City, CA base pay range for a new hire in this role is $169,000.00 - $232,100.00. New hires are typically hired into the lower portion of the range, enabling employee growth in the range over time. Actual placement in range is based on job-related skills and experience, as evaluated throughout the interview process.

This position may be eligible to participate in our discretionary annual performance bonus program. Bonus eligibility and targets are determined in accordance with our total rewards philosophy and may vary by role.

**Better Together**
-------------------

As we grow, we're excited to strengthen in-person connections and cultivate a collaborative, team-oriented environment. This role is a hybrid position requiring you to be onsite for at least 60% of the working month, approximately 3 days a week, with specific in-office days determined by the team's manager. The exact schedule will be at the hiring manager's discretion and communicated during the interview process.

* Provides a generous employer match on employee 401(k) contributions to support planning for the future.
* Paid time off to volunteer at an organization of your choice.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Senior Program Manager, Multidisciplinary Teams (MDTs)

**Department:** Strategic Partnerships & Policy (SPP)

**Reports to:** Chief Policy Officer (CPO)

**Location:** 3450 Third Street, San Francisco, CA 94124

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**

Safe & Sound's mission is to prevent and reduce the impact of childhood abuse, neglect, and trauma. We do this by strengthening families, building communities, and advancing healing, equity, and justice. We envision a future free from childhood trauma, where all children, families, and communities are safe, supported, and loved.

Combining direct services, training and capacity building, research, and advocacy to strengthen families in their communities, address childhood trauma, and prevent abuse, Safe & Sound has evolved into a premiere child-serving organization, bringing over 50 years of service to our community.

We reach more than 11,000 caregivers and children annually with our unique coordinated, multi-generational approach that spans the entire spectrum of prevention and intervention to strengthen family resilience and address factors that put families at risk for experiencing abuse or involvement in unsubstantiated abuse allegations.

The organization has an annual operating budget of approximately $10.8 million and is supported by approximately 55 staff, interns, and more than 100 volunteers. Safe & Sound headquarters is located in a historic firehouse in the Haight-Ashbury neighborhood of San Francisco, with a second office in the Bayview neighborhood.

More information is available at: .

**OVERALL SUMMARY**

The Senior Program Manager (SPM), Multidisciplinary Teams (MDTs) provides strategic leadership for Safe & Sound’s role in San Francisco’s city-wide, multi-disciplinary teams that seek to advance system enhancement and improve the response to abused and exploited children. This is a leadership role, not a coordination role: the SPM sets direction, owns the data and the story it tells, leads the meetings, and drives the work forward between them, serving as a thought partner with agency partners and funders.

These teams include the Children’s Advocacy Center (CAC), the Working Group and Steering Committee for children and youth experiencing sexual exploitation (Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children, CSEC), the Child Death Review Team (CDRT), and the Family Violence Council (FVC).

The SPM, MDTs holds an important role in implementing the department’s strategic direction. The SPM will work with external stakeholders and community and public partners to:

(1) enhance the coordinated, multidisciplinary approach to investigating child abuse allegations and providing trauma-informed services for victims of child abuse and exploitation;

(2) develop policies, protocols, procedures, and other data-informed solutions to improve complex systems challenges in the child abuse response structure;

(3) reduce re-victimization and the devastating long-term effects of child abuse and exploitation on children, their families, and society;

(4) increase coordinated case planning and service delivery for victims; and

(5) turn the patterns and learnings that surface across the teams into recommendations for practice, policy, and prevention.

The ideal candidate is familiar with child abuse, commercial sexual exploitation of children, and/or other areas of family violence, and with government systems and public policy. The position requires excellent project management and facilitation skills; strong written and verbal communication; experience in relationship-building and stakeholder engagement; strong analytical and organizational abilities; and the independence and initiative to identify what needs to happen, propose a plan with dates, and carry it through without step-by-step direction.

The position is a supervisory role that reports to the Chief Policy Officer, supervises the MDT Coordinator, collaborates with other SPP staff, receives strategic direction from the partners of the multi-disciplinary teams, and works frequently with representatives from San Francisco child welfare, law enforcement, public health, and other public and community agencies responding to family violence.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Strategic Leadership and Thought Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Human Services Agency (HSA), other public funders, and partner agency leaders: learn what each partner needs from each team, bring ideas and options, and propose how the work can deliver more, rather than waiting for direction.
* Develop, with the CPO, a vision and annual priorities for each MDT, grounded in funder scopes of work, contract requirements, best practice, and partner input.
* Consolidate recommendations and patterns from the MDTs into actionable policy and practice changes that address barriers for children and youth interfacing with systems.
* Build structured learning into team meetings, such as reflection questions on what the group has learned and de-identified case briefs that partners can carry back to their leadership.
* Identify policy and legislative opportunities that emerge from MDT work and develop them with the CPO and the Senior Policy Advisor.

**Facilitation and Meeting Leadership**

* Own the agenda, preparation, facilitation (or co-facilitation where a partner agency facilitates), and follow-up for key MDT meetings and decision-making processes, so that Safe & Sound leads rather than supports.
* Establish and uphold group agreements so partners can examine what went wrong in a case or system without assigning blame.
* Disseminate information and materials, monitor logistics, and keep a running agenda and action-item tracker for each team.
* Ensure follow-up on action items so that team priorities move forward in a timely fashion.

**Family Violence Council, Data, and Research**

* Own Safe & Sound’s contribution to the Family Violence Council, including attending and preparing for council meeting

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
MongoDB is seeking a technical, execution-obsessed individual to join the Recruiting Operations team as a RecOps Partner. In this role, you will oversee RecTech and Process Optimization, serving as the primary strategic partner and operational liaison to HR Tech, translating Talent Acquisition strategy into an actionable systems roadmap. You will architect complex operational workflows, drive complex, multi-quarter roadmaps and bring the technical fluency and business acumen needed to evaluate the viability and impact of technical solutions.

Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, CoreOps, you will operate with high autonomy to drive cross-functional execution and change management. You will provide strategic guidance, technical domain oversight, and peer mentorship to other individuals within the team, supporting them as individual product owners of their deliverables while elevating operational rigor across the team.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City, Austin, Palo Alto, or San Francisco for our hybrid working model.

### **What You'll Do**

* Drive RecTech Modernization & Tooling Strategy: Act as the primary liaison to HR Tech to distill TA vision into a cohesive technology roadmap. Oversee high-complexity initiatives, such as the deployment of our Offer-to-Hire workflow using AI and automation and pilots for enterprise-grade interview and debrief intelligence suites
* Architect Complex Workflows & Systems: Develop end-to-end process maps for all key recruiting workflows to identify friction points and structural opportunities. Architect major workflow redesigns, such as overhauling the end-to-end offer process to minimize manual interventions
* Optimize Greenhouse as a Core System of Work: Consolidate high-priority issue areas across the hiring lifecycle to eliminate fragmented, manual workflows. Leverage native Greenhouse features and strategic integrations to standardize processes, lower compliance risks, eliminate administrative overhead, and elevate data integrity
* Drive Cross-Functional Execution & Autonomy: Independently own and drive goals, steering change management and adoption across global teams for all systems and process updates. Resolve complex escalations, operating with autonomy while proactively flagging for support when necessary
* Mentor Junior Members of the Team: Act as a dedicated mentor and sounding board for the RecTech and Process Optimization sub-domain owners, supporting their development into strong Product Owners without having direct administrative or people management duties
* Leverage Data to Drive Strategic Outcomes: Proactively identify internal TA needs (recruiters, coordinators, hiring teams), act as a compelling communicator across cross-functional groups, and regularly leverage data diagnostics to drive operational outcomes

### **What You'll Bring**

* Advanced Expertise: 8+ years of experience architecting complex operational workflows, recruiting technology evaluations and implementations, and multi-quarter systems roadmaps
* Scope & Complexity: Proven track record of independently owning multi-faceted goals, driving cross-functional execution, and resolving complex operational escalations. Operates with high autonomy and demonstrates sound judgment on when to flag for escalation
* Commitment to Mentorship & Influence: Proactively identifies TA needs, acts as a compelling communicator across technical and non-technical stakeholders, and demonstrates a proven ability to mentor and uplevel junior team members
* Technical Aptitude & Tooling Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of core recruiting platforms (e.g., Greenhouse, Gem, Guide). Proven track record of evaluating tool ROI systematically, sunsetting redundant platforms, and experimenting with automations and AI in recruiting workflows
* Workflow Architecture & People Team Alignment: Demonstrated experience redesigning complex hiring workflows and partnering with downstream teams (HRIS, HR Operations, FP&A) to ensure cross-system alignment and data hygiene
* Hands-On Data Fluency: Comfortability extracting and diagnosing pipeline and operational data directly in Google Sheets using advanced formulas to run ad-hoc analyses and diagnose root causes

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Account Manager

Global Fire and Safety is hiring an Account Manager to prepare cost estimates and customer quotes for marine fire suppression, detection, and life-saving equipment. You’ll work from customer requests for quotes (RFQs), parts lists, and supplier catalogs to source equipment, evaluate pricing and lead times, calculate margins, and build proposals in Salesforce.

You’ll work with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, Logistics, Accounting, and field technicians to support customer service, inspections, repairs, and renewals. The team shares responsibility for customer service, and you’ll be accountable for the quotes and assignments you handle. Assignments may shift as workloads and business priorities change.

**What you’ll do**

* Prepare itemized estimates, bills of materials, and proposals for marine equipment, spare parts, and equipment packages.
* Request and compare quotes from manufacturers, distributors, and freight partners. Evaluate availability, lead times, freight costs, delivery commitments, and supplier reliability.
* Apply pricing guidelines, volume discounts, and target margins. Recommend pricing exceptions, alternate suppliers, or revised terms for nonstandard requests.
* Advise leadership on whether to pursue, revise, or decline complex bids based on profitability, supplier risk, and the ability to meet customer commitments. Document the rationale for significant recommendations.
* Prepare proposals with itemized pricing, lead times, payment terms, and exclusions for Sales or Account Management review.
* Track quotes, supplier pricing, and bid results in Salesforce and Uptick. Use supplier performance and bid history to recommend improvements to sourcing and quoting practices.
* Hand off won quotes and supporting vendor documentation to Purchasing, Logistics, and Order Fulfillment.
* Communicate promptly with customers and internal teams, keep quote records accurate, and cross-train to support changing workloads.

**What you’ll bring**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Experience in commercial estimating, inside sales quoting, procurement, or industrial equipment supply.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Uptick or comparable quoting or field service software.
* Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions such as VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, and pricing spreadsheets.
* Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple quote deadlines and communicate clearly with customers, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Two or more years of maritime industry experience.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or a related field.
* Familiarity with marine or industrial fire and life safety equipment, such as extinguishers, suppression cylinders and components, alarm components, self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA), life jackets, or life rafts.

This role primarily involves computer and telephone work in an office setting and may involve occasionally lifting or moving items up to 20 pounds. jobs.description:
**Be Part of an Amazing Story**

  

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

  

**Job Overview**

  

The Starbucks Daily Operations Leader directs daily operations of the licensed Starbucks café inside Macy’s, ensuring an efficient, professional, safe, and profitable operation while upholding Starbucks brand standards and Macy’s Foods Division expectations. The Daily Operations Leader works alongside Baristas to deliver quality customer service and expertly crafted beverages, modeling the operational standards that define the Starbucks Experience.

  

The Daily Operations Leader coaches and develops team members, maintains an encouraging and energetic work environment, and partners with leadership to support sales, profitability, and compliance goals. In this role, the Daily Operations Leader positively influences others, strengthens leadership skills, and creates an uplifting experience for both customers and colleagues.

All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found* *here**.*

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead daily café operations, ensuring compliance with Starbucks, Macy’s Foods Division, and Health Department standards for safety, sanitation, and product quality.
* Deliver an exceptional customer experience by modeling Starbucks’ customer connection standards and Macy’s Selling behaviors.
* Train, coach, and motivate colleagues through ongoing feedback and role modeling to maximize team performance, customer satisfaction, and professional development.
* Ensure consistent preparation, presentation, and merchandising of all food and beverages to Starbucks standards, making necessary recipe adjustments (e.g., temperature, ingredient quantities, or substitutions) to meet customer requests.
* Monitor labor productivity to balance customer service needs with cost control.
* Assist with ordering, receiving, inventory management, and invoice processing to maintain stock levels and achieve targeted food and beverage costs.
* Monitor sales, expenses, and reports to achieve profit and loss goals, and communicate results and priorities to the team and leadership.
* Oversee cash handling and point-of-sale operations in compliance with Macy’s and Starbucks policies.
* Maintain a clean, professional, and welcoming café environment, serving as a role model for grooming, communication, and workplace conduct.
* Partner with store leadership and Starbucks Division Managers to ensure operational excellence and promptly resolve customer concerns.
* Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
* In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

  

**Skills You Will Need**

  

**Leadership & Coaching** – Demonstrates strong leadership, communication, and coaching skills to engage, develop, and motivate a high-performing team.

**Customer Focus** – Commits to delivering exceptional customer experiences and effectively resolves concerns to maintain satisfaction and loyalty.

**Organizational & Problem-Solving Skills** – Applies solid organizational and problem-solving abilities to manage multiple priorities and ensure smooth café operations.

**Business Acumen** – Understands basic business principles to support sales goals, control expenses, and ensure accurate cash handling.

**Food Safety & Compliance** – Knowledgeable in food safety, sanitation, and regulatory standards, maintaining a clean, safe, and compliant café environment.

  

**Who You Are**

  

* Candidates with a High School diploma or equivalent are encouraged to apply. Retail, food service, or customer service experience preferred.
* Must be ServSafe certified or have food handler permit as required by state or local health department.
* This position requires heavy lifting, constant moving, remaining in a stationary position, and reaching with arms and hands. Involves remaining in a stationary position for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 30 lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders. May involve reaching above eye level. Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
* Able to work a flexible schedule, including days, evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on department and company needs.

  

**What We Can Offer You**

  

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. jobs.title: Senior Analyst for AI, Data & Systems (Enablement)
jobs.description:
**Aspire Public Schools NorCal — Senior Analyst for AI, Data & Systems (Enablement)**

**Job Description**

**About Aspire NorCal**

Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres).

This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools.

Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long-standing mission focused on post-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead.

**About the AI, Data & Systems Enablement team**

The Data & Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations & Principals, Academics & Teachers, and People & Resources. Our working principles: go deep with users, one shared foundation, self-serve first, learning is the job, and nobody works alone.

**About the role**

Reporting to the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Enablement, the Senior Analyst for AI, Data & Systems (Enablement) helps the Enablement team keep the shared foundation running while learning data engineering, platform administration, and AI enablement from experienced teammates. The role supports the team's shared platforms and the warehouse, and grows toward a Lead Analyst role or a data engineering path. This is a growth role, working alongside the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering as part of the Enablement team.

This posting is for one opening.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle day-to-day administration of the shared platforms (Zendesk, Slack, Monday.com, and other shared productivity tools) under the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Enablement: user setup, permissions, configuration, and documentation.
* Support the Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering: run and check data-quality tests, keep warehouse and integration documentation current, and watch integration jobs and flag failures.
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Lightdash.
* Take requests from the pods and the team, find the root cause rather than only closing the ticket, and propose ways to prevent issues.
* Keep the team's records current: the approved AI tools list, the prompt and training library, and the shared backlog.
* Help onboard new teammates to the team's standups, backlog and documentation standards.
* Take part in the team's learning: pairing, standups, and AI and data-skills practice, with protected learning time.

**How we work**

This is a team of people who are smart, driven, and humble. Learning is part of the job, with time protected for it. We expect everyone to learn out loud, ask for help early, teach what they know, and use AI to give time back to the people we serve. Nobody works alone: you will pair with teammates, document what you learn, and cover for each other.

**Qualifications**

**Mindsets (required)**

* **Intellectual humility:** curious enough to ask the question that shows what you don't know, and secure enough to laugh at yourself.
* **Interest in AI that serves Aspire's mission:** has tried AI tools on real work (at a job, in school, or on your own), and wants to help colleagues use AI to give time back to teachers, principals, and teammates.
* **Teaches, coaches, and keeps learning:** learns from colleagues, customers, and mistakes.
* **Service-minded:** treats principals, teachers, and teammates as customers.

**Experience (required)**

* 2+ years in a data, systems, support, or similar role.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets, and learns new tools quickly.
* Clear written and spoken communication.
* Careful with sensitive data, and follows access and privacy rules.

**Bonus points for**

* SQL or BI-tool experience.
* K-12 or nonprofit experience.
* Experience with a help desk or ticketing tool.
* An AI workflow or automation you built that colleagues still use.

**Compensation and benefits**
-----------------------------

The salary range for this role is $84,564 to $108,556 annually in accordance with our salary schedule policy, commensurate with experience. This full-time, exempt position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Eligible for Aspire health benefits
* Retirement through CalSTRS or CalPERS, depending on the role's credential requirements, with a 403(b) option
* Paid time off and additional teammate benefits to be determined in accordance with updated employe

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**
-----------------

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who We Are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.  
Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.  
Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.  
Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an HR Generalist to own the operational backbone of People at Bobyard: payroll, benefits, leave, compliance, onboarding, offboarding, and HR systems. You will be our third Operations hire and second HR hire, reporting to our People lead and working closely with Finance, Talent, IT, and our outside vendors.

This is a hands-on role. You will run payroll, partner with vendors to register us in new states, support benefits, leave, and onboarding, and field the questions that land in our People inbox every day. You will also spot what is breaking as we grow and build the tracker, template, or workflow that fixes it.

You will thrive here if you love getting the details right, can juggle a lot of moving parts without dropping any, and bring warmth to every employee interaction while still holding clear boundaries.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Payroll and compensation operations**

* Process payroll across multiple schedules (bi-weekly and semi-monthly, global) in Rippling, including new hires, terminations, pay changes, commissions, and off-cycle runs.
* Review payroll for accuracy before approval and resolve employee pay questions.
* Partner with our outside accounting firm on payroll tax notices and state agency mail.

**Multi-state and international compliance**

* Partner with vendors to register Bobyard in new states as we hire there, and help keep our state accounts in good standing.
* Help maintain the employee handbook, state supplements, and required postings as laws change.
* Support wage and hour compliance, including exempt and non-exempt classification reviews.
* Manage I-9s, records retention, and audit-ready employee files.
* Track required training (harassment prevention, security awareness) and follow up until completion.

**Benefits and leave administration**

* Support benefits administration with our broker and providers, including enrollments, life events, and COBRA.
* Support open enrollment, from employee communications to post-enrollment audit.
* Support leaves of absence with our leave vendor, including state paid family leave claims and payroll top-up calculations.
* Be a friendly, plain-language answer to employee benefits and PTO questions.

**Onboarding and offboarding**

* Support the new hire experience from signed offer to Day 1: Rippling setup, paperwork, IT and equipment requests, calendars, and welcome communications, with a path to owning onboarding as you ramp.
* Help coordinate weekly start cohorts and their Day 1 and Week 1 schedules.
* Support offboarding, including final pay, benefits, access removal, equipment return, and required state notices.

**HR systems, data, and documents**

* Be our in-house Rippling expert: workflows, approvals, reporting, and clean employee data.
* Maintain the People team intake form and trackers, keeping requests moving and nothing dropped.
* Prepare employment change documents, such as offer, promotion, and change of status letters, for People lead approval.

**Vendors and special projects**

* Be a day-to-day contact for People vendors: payroll, benefits broker, 401(k), leave management, and immigration counsel.
* Support projects that keep a fast-growing company running, like address changes across agencies and policy rollouts.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Must haves**

* 3 to 5 years of HR generalist or People Ops experience, ideally at a venture-backed startup.
* Hands-on, multi-state payroll experience, including California.
* Working knowledge of US employment law: wage and hour, leaves, final pay, and classification.
* Comfort administering benefits and leaves end to end.
* Experience with Rippling or a comparable HRIS, and confidence in spreadsheets.
* Sharp attention to detail. You double check the numbers before they go out.
* Clear, warm writing, and the discretion to handle sensitive information.
* A bias for action. You see a gap, propose a fix, and ship it.

**Nice to haves**

* Experience working with vendors to register a company in new states, or supporting employees in another country.
* Commission payroll experience.
* Experience working with a leave management vendor.
* PHR, SHRM-CP, or a similar certification.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

* $100,000–$120,000 base + bonus + 0.01%–0.03% equity (4-year vest)
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!

Come build with us!

Compensation Range: $100K - $120K

jobs.description:
### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

**Set the Foundation for Time-Critical Order Execution**
--------------------------------------------------------

Airspace moves the shipments that can't be late — for hospitals waiting on an organ, a grounded aircraft waiting on a part, or a production line waiting on a component. As an Operations Specialist I, you're one of the first people to touch a new order, and how well you set it up determines whether everything downstream goes smoothly.

This is where every Airspace Operations career starts. You'll learn the platform, the players (customers, Commanders, and agent service providers), and the judgment calls that come with time-critical logistics. The role is deliberately structured to build your foundation fast, so that by the time you're ready to advance, the fundamentals are second nature.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Operate the Airspace Platform**

* Set up new orders by adhering to standard work practices and client-specific SOP instructions
* Apply transit accessorials (e.g., wait time, parking, tolls) in PT as reported — for charges that are not auto-generated by the system
* Navigate and interpret carrier booking and tracking systems relevant to the order
* Accurately confirm job milestones are completed correctly and on time
* Rapidly move between competing priorities without losing accuracy

### **Solve Problems as They Arise**

* Source driver coverage for any segment of an order
* Use situational awareness to request or deny additional driver incentives when necessary
* Update, manage, and/or change shipment documentation as needed
* Apply training and tenured knowledge to find solutions to common or uncommon issues
* Follow escalation procedures and guidance from senior team members when a situation exceeds your judgment

### **Keep Customers Informed**

* Professionally relay delays, issues, and updates through verbal and written communication
* Anticipate disruptions (weather, traffic, carrier delays) and proactively offer alternatives to meet or beat required delivery times
* Place orders on behalf of customers who are unable to use the online portal

### **Stay Responsive Across Channels**

* Timely acknowledgment and action on all email, phone, and text requests
* Consistently meet minimum metric expectations for phone availability and acceptance
* Proper use of phone statuses; adherence to All Hands on Deck and Off-Phones guidelines
* Stay independently informed by reviewing all communications provided throughout company platforms

### **Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance**

As an OS I, you'll be expected to meet minimum metric requirements and customer service standards appropriate for an entry-level position. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor. Expectations increase with each advancement.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* Prior logistics experience preferred, but not required — we'll train you on the platform, the workflows, and the judgment calls
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable on the phone with customers under time pressure
* High attention to detail — small errors in time-critical logistics have outsized consequences
* Ability to multitask and shift rapidly between competing priorities
* Comfortable following structured processes while also using judgment when a situation falls outside the standard playbook
* Willingness to obtain any certifications required for your assigned sector (e.g., Dangerous Goods handling, where applicable)
* Available to work the shift pattern required by your team, including some evenings, weekends, or holidays as the network requires
* Available for 2 weeks of training in person on-site in our Carlsbad, CA headquarters

**Advancement to Operations Specialist II**
-------------------------------------------

Advancement is a gate, not a timeline — tenure alone doesn't move you forward. To advance to OS II, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

* Minimum of 6 months in the OS I role
* Consistently meeting or exceeding OS I performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed at your first structured Semi-Annual Review (SAR)
* Demonstrated proficiency across all OS I responsibilities with minimal supervision
* Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to independently own the additional judgment calls required at OS II

At Interplay, we pair hands-on, instructor-led training with digital training, simulations and skill verification to help trades technicians learn, grow and build better careers. In this role, you’ll support the open enrollment, instructor-led courses at our training centers, including crane operation, rigging, inspection, lift planning and NCCCO certification prep. This role blends people and process. You’ll be a main point of contact for students and customers through phone call and email. Along with keeping accurate records, rosters and payments in our systems. Experience with customer service or program coordination/management and data entry is highly preferred.

* Mission-driven company and innovative product offering
* Career development in a dynamic, high growth environment
* Passionate, collaborative team
* Real variety: customer service, data, coordination and a sales support

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The Associate Project Manager joins the Transformation team as Proven Winners brings three legacy companies together into one organization. Reporting to the Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) and working day to day with the Project Manager, this role keeps transformation projects on track for the CTO, the Project Manager, and the transformation officers from the company's private equity partner: meeting notes, action items, follow through between meetings, and current project status. The role also manages smaller assigned projects and supports the larger, higher-complexity programs led by the Transformation team and executive sponsors. Assignments are scaled to complexity and grow as the person demonstrates results.

**Essential Functions**

*Project Coordination & Follow Through*

* Take notes and capture decisions/ action items in project meetings led by the CTO, the Project Manager, and the private equity partner's transformation officers.
* Follow up with owners between meetings so action items are resolved, next steps stay clear, and nothing drifts.
* Keep Monday.com boards, status, and open item lists current across assigned projects so project leads always know current statuses.
* Prepare agendas, pre-reads, and status inputs so project leads can run streamlined meetings.

*Process Scoping & Harmonization*

* Help scope undocumented and undefined business processes with business owners and SMES at each company through interviews, walkthroughs, process maps, and SOP drafts.
* Support current state analysis across the companies, help identify harmonization opportunities and their business benefit, and help draft future state recommendations.
* Help prepare prioritization materials for the executive and transformation steering committees, and carry approved initiatives into defined, resourced projects.

*Project Delivery*

* Manage smaller assigned transformation projects with guidance from the Project Manager: charter, scope, milestone- and work stream-level plan with named owners and specific due dates, risk, issues, decisions, change control, and close-out.
* Build and maintain each project's Monday.com board to the workspace standard; keep status, milestones, and executive summaries current weekly.
* Support vendor delivered project plan, track vendor deliverables and dates, and flag misses early to the project lead.

*Executive & Stakeholder Communication*

* Contribute to updates for executive leadership, including portfolio status, issues, and decisions required.
* Translate technical and project management language into terms business teams understand and translate business needs back into requirements that vendors and technical teams can act on.

*PMO Standards, Coaching, & Adoption*

* Apply and help maintain the Transformation Project Management Office (PMO) standards: project intake, project formats, board templates, status definitions, risk/ issue/ decision logs, and the executive update format.
* Help functional teams move toward SOP-driven operations with the documentation trail to support them; contribute to self serve training materials and guides.
* Identify where the standards are not working for a team and propose practical, lightweight fixes.

**Education & Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of project coordination or project management experience.
* Experience documenting business processes (process mapping, current state/ future state analysis, SOP development) in operations, manufacturing, distribution, agriculture, horticulture, or similar environments.

*Technical Proficiency*

* Business process mapping and analysis tools (Lucidchart, Visio, or similar)
* Strong Microsoft 365 skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint/ OneDrive)
* Hands-on experience with work management or PPM platforms (Monday.com, Smartsheet, Asana, Wrike, MS Project, or similar)

*Soft Skills*

* Clear, direct, concise written and verbal communication; able to brief senior leadership in plan language and explain technical or PMO concepts to people hearing them for the first time.
* Diplomatic persistence: holds vendors, peers, and senior stakeholders to their commitments without damaging relationships.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities; builds a plan from incomplete information and refines it as facts come in.

**Hour & Travel Expectations**

* Full-time position: operating within standard business hours with flexibility to work extended hours in accordance with business needs.

jobs.title: Customer Organization Program Manager
jobs.description:
*\*An internal or pre-identified candidate is currently under consideration, but all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.*

  

**Customer Organization Program Manager**

  

Join Epicor as a Program manager! The Customer Organization Program Manager owns the development of Epicor's FY27 sales plays from strategy to enablement. You will turn identified sales plays into playbooks, content and training that help sellers lead with business outcomes, not features.

  

You'll sit at the center of Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Generation. You'll build the programs and hand-offs that connect them, so every launch, campaign and training lands as one cohesive story for sellers and customers. This is a new role on a growing Revenue Enablement team, with the ability to influence how Epicor goes to market.

  

**What you will be doing**

  

**Own the sales plays**

  

* Build and maintain a playbook for each FY27 sales play: target personas (CFO, COO, CIO, CXO), verticals, discovery questions, value messages, proof points, objection handling and competitive positioning.

* Identify the content each play needs at each sales stage, audit what exists, and fill the gaps.

* Coordinate content development between Sales, Product Marketing and SMEs, managing timelines, owners and approvals.

* Coordinate rollout and training for each play alongside enablement lead, from launch sessions to manager coaching guides and reinforcement.

Run the rolling 2-quarter enablement roadmap with Product Marketing, so product launches are packaged into play-based training.  

  

**Strengthen the Marketing–Sales partnership**

  

* Design programs and clear hand-offs between Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales, from MQL to SAL through to Discovery.

* Act as stakeholder from Sales on Insight conference development and delivery.

* Align campaign messaging with sales plays so sellers can follow up on what marketing starts.

Set up feedback loops with sellers and sales leaders and bring field insight back to Marketing and Product.  

  

**Activate plays in market**

  

* Work with Marketing and regional sales leaders on market activation: campaigns, events, account-based programs and partner motions tied to each play.

* Work with enablement lead to select the right format for each audience and moment, such as live sessions, microlearning, play kits, battlecards, talk tracks, demo stories and digital sales rooms.

Write clear, compelling seller-facing communications for launches, play updates and program news.  

  

**Measure and improve**

  

* Define and report success measures for each play: adoption, content usage, pipeline created and win rate in the target segment.

Use the data to refine plays, retire content that isn't working, and prioritize what comes next.  

  

**Other enablement projects**

  

* Support broader Customer Organization strategic initiatives, including leader programs, sales kickoffs, onboarding and tools rollouts, and others as assigned.

Support with Chief of Staff duties as assigned.  

  

**What you will likely bring**

  

* 10+ years of experience across sales enablement, product or solution marketing, sales programs, or marketing communications in B2B technology. Experience in an ERP organization or similar complex SaaS is required.

* A track record of building sales plays, playbooks or go-to-market programs that sellers actually use.

* Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex product capabilities into clear business outcome and value messages.

* Program management discipline: you can run multiple workstreams, timelines and stakeholders at once and keep them on track.

* Experience influencing without authority across Sales, Marketing and Product, including with senior leaders.

* Comfort designing and delivering training, both live and virtual, to sales audiences.

* An analytical mindset, with experience using CRM and enablement data to measure impact.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

  

**What could set you apart**

  

* Background in communications or PR, especially message development, internal communications or change communications.

* Experience with ERP, supply chain or industry software sold to manufacturing, distribution, retail, automotive or building supply businesses.

* Familiarity with value selling, MEDDICC, Challenger or similar sales methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Highspot, Seismic or an LMS.

* Experience with account-based marketing, demand generation programs or partner enablement.

* Experience using AI tools to speed up content creation, research or enablement delivery.

Prior experience leading or mentoring others, or a desire to build a team.  

  

**What success looks like in your first year**

  

* **First 60 days:** Learn the four plays, sellers and stakeholders. Audit existing content against each play, and build first sales play.

* **By 6 months:** Launch complete playbooks for at least three plays, with training delivered to Account Executives/TMs and CAMs, and an agreed Marketing-to-Sales hand-off process.

* **By 12 months:** All four plays are live and refreshed quarterly. Fewer standalone feature trainings reach sellers, and play adoption and pipeline impact are reported to leadership each quarter.

From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Legence is hiring a Payroll Implementation Manager who will manage the end-to-end implementation lifecycle (discovery, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support) for our payroll function. The ideal candidate will have experience configuring payroll systems, leading payroll implementations, and training payroll teams on new systems.

* Project Management: Lead the end-to-end implementation lifecycle (discovery, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support) for the payroll team.
* Business Requirement Gathering: Analyze business needs to configure HR, payroll, and tax systems appropriately.
* System Configuration: Set up payroll modules, pay codes, tax configurations, and company structures within the software.
* Data Migration & Validation: Oversee the migration of union rates from legacy systems, ensuring accuracy and reconciling figures.
* Data interfaces: Collaborate with other teams to design, develop, and test data interfaces between systems.
* Documentation: Create or modify work instructions and metrics for payroll team that are a result of system implementations.
* Training & Support: Train payroll team on the new system and provide support through the first few pay cycles.

**Desired Experience and Qualifications:**

**Job title:** Program Manager - Product Launch Delivery

**Reports to:** Staff Technical Program Manager

**Department:** Central Services

**Location:** Alpharetta, GA/Remote

**Grade:** 19

**About Priority:**

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

This role owns a multi-project program within one of the product workstreams — Banking and Treasury, Priority Commerce Engine, Merchant and Partner Solutions, or a Core Platform Shared Services domain such as billing or payment rails. You will coordinate several concurrent projects and their interdependencies across engineering, product, and operations, holding one plan and one version of status for the program.

This is an individual contributor role within the Enterprise PMO's Product Launch Delivery tower. It owns how the work ships, not what ships or how it is architected. The role reports to the tower's Delivery Lead and works to the methodology and reporting standards set by PMO Operations and CoE. Customer implementations sit in a separate tower, and product-facing software delivery sits in Product Launch Delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Owns delivery of a multi-project program within an assigned product workstream, including schedule, scope integrity, and dependency management across its constituent projects.
* Maintains the program plan, milestones, critical path, and RAID log, and keeps them current enough to be used for decisions rather than for reporting.
* Coordinates cross-functional delivery across engineering, product, quality, and operations to a shared date.
* Produces effort and duration estimates for planned work, and flags feasibility before a date is committed.
* Runs the delivery cadence for the program: planning, standing reviews, dependency checkpoints, and escalation.
* Manages release entry and exit criteria for the program's releases, partnering with Release Coordination on deployment readiness.
* Carries regulatory and control requirements as plan items where the program touches SOC 2 or PCI DSS scope.
* Reports program status through the EPMO Intelligence Portal to the standards set by PMO Operations and CoE.
* Mentors project managers and associate project managers working within the program.
* Contributes patterns and lessons learned to the launch playbook through the quarterly pattern loop.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* The program delivers to its committed dates, and slippage is forecast rather than discovered.
* Dependencies between the program's projects are visible and sequenced, not resolved by escalation.
* Engineering and product partners work from one plan and one version of status.
* Scope changes arrive through a defined route with effort and date impact attached, rather than as verbal commitments.
* Release readiness is evidenced, and post-release defects are the exception.
* Project managers in the program grow measurably against the next level's scope.

**Candidate Requirements:**

**Required**

* 6–8 years in project or program management, including ownership of a multi-project program with interdependencies.
* Experience delivering software or platform work across more than one engineering team.
* Working fluency with integration and release mechanics: environments, dependency sequencing, release criteria, and UAT.
* Demonstrated cross-functional coordination without direct authority.
* Disciplined execution mechanics: an honest critical path, actively used RAID logs, and status reporting leadership can act on.
* Experience in a regulated delivery environment such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS.
* Fluency with both agile and waterfall delivery approaches.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification.
* Payments or fintech domain exposure: acquiring, banking and treasury, payables, billing, or payment rails.
* Experience working with an offshore development team.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Ai tooling.
* Exposure to Lean or Six Sigma methods applied to cycle-time reduction.

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Compensation range:** [$120k-$145k]  
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

jobs.description:

This job, and the team at Instinct, is remote.

As a QA Lead, you will play a key role in testing modern veterinary software that serves thousands of users in animal hospitals across the globe. Those in this role often take ownership of test plan creation and execution, and have the ability to provide feedback on software quality and product development. You will work closely and provide leadership to a small, cross-functional, highly-collaborative team to deliver quality software that solves real problems for our customers. Our teams have a deep understanding of their domains and work to deliver value with minimal overhead. We prize excellence, creativity, and accountability and in return provide autonomy and an environment to do your best work.

* Collaborate with your team to understand requirements and ensure quality is built into every stage of the development lifecycle
* Identify, document, and track bugs and defects using tracking tools, providing clear and actionable feedback to the development team
* Conduct manual testing as necessary, focusing on critical paths and edge cases to ensure software meets high-quality standards
* Develop and maintain test plans to support regression, functional, and integration testing
* Analyze testing outcomes and generate reports to communicate results to stakeholders, recommending process improvements where applicable

  + Team-first attitude, including a strong desire to collaborate with your teammates and strive for excellence in software delivery

  + Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis and database navigation

* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.

* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.

The compensation range for this role is $110,000 - $150,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

The role also directs and develops the Shared Services team as its formal people manager, and coaches the early-career team members who rotate through it. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
About the Role
  
Lead sales enablement strategy and execution for Enterprise and Mid-Market, ensuring sellers and customer-facing teams can confidently translate product, brand, and campaign strategies into relevant customer conversations and effective sales motions.
  
Create and maintain the collateral, tools, training, playbooks, programs, and communications required to improve seller readiness, consistency, adoption, and productivity. Carry initiatives from needs assessment and design through launch, reinforcement, measurement, and continuous improvement.
  
Partner across Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Product, Sales Operations, Learning and Development, Digital, Internal Communications, and Creative Services to align enablement with business priorities and frontline realities.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
Enablement Strategy & Planning
  

* Segment enablement strategy: Build enablement plans aligned to Enterprise and Mid-Market sales motions, roles, customer needs, products, campaigns, and growth priorities.
* Needs assessment: Use seller feedback, performance data, customer insights, launch plans, and leadership priorities to identify readiness gaps and focus resources.
* Enablement roadmap: Manage a prioritized roadmap and calendar connecting launches, campaigns, seasonal programs, sales meetings, tools, and training.
* Cross-functional governance: Create clear intake, development, approval, launch, maintenance, and retirement processes for enablement materials and programs.

Content, Tools & Training
  

* Collateral and tools: Develop and govern customer-facing and seller-facing collateral, presentations, battlecards, discovery guides, talk tracks, proposal content, and digital tools.
* Playbooks: Build practical playbooks for priority products, segments, use cases, campaigns, competitors, cross-sell motions, and account-development opportunities.
* Training and readiness: Design and facilitate training that builds knowledge, confidence, skills, and application, using reinforcement and manager support to sustain adoption.
* Launch enablement: Translate GTM strategy into seller-ready materials, training, FAQs, objection handling, proof points, and launch communications.
* Sales kickoffs and communications: Lead enablement for sales kickoffs, launches, recurring sales forums, and internal social or communications streams such as Uconnect.

Sales Programs & Adoption
  

* Referral programs: Design and support referral motions with clear eligibility, messaging, tools, handoffs, tracking, and field communications.
* Incentives and recognition: Partner with Sales Leadership, Finance, HR, and Operations on targeted incentives and recognition programs, including major recognition experiences such as President’s Club where assigned.
* Adoption and reinforcement: Drive usage of approved messaging, collateral, tools, and processes through manager reinforcement, communications, office hours, and field feedback loops.

jobs.title: AI Specialist & Executive Program Lead
jobs.description:
**AI Specialist & Executive Program Lead**
==========================================

**Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE)** | Reports to the [CRO ] | [Location - Remote]

**Salary range:** $108,500 - $147,000, plus variable pay and RSUs.

**How We Got Here**
-------------------

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

* **B2 Overdrive** - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
* **B2 Neo** - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
* **B2 Cloud Storage** - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
* **Computer Backup** - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

**The Role**
------------

Multimodal AI data (video, images, audio, and sensor logs) drives the largest new storage needs in AI. It starts with AI builders: physical AI and robotics teams, generative media model companies, and the data providers that feed them. It moves through neoclouds, data platforms, and investors who shape where it lives. Backblaze is the high-performance capacity storage layer for AI. You will put us in front of these builders before the storage decision is made.

This role does two jobs. As the AI Builder Specialist, you own a short list of Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts and pursue them from first executive conversation to a qualified handoff to Sales. As the Executive Program Lead, you design and run the dinners, side events, advocacy sessions, and roundtables that open those doors, and you carry the message that makes executives want to attend.

The role encompasses BD and Corporate Development Lead as the owner of our Executive Outreach Program in phase 1, and Customer-Partner Advisory Leader in phase 2 (within one quarter of start).

This is not an inbound role. If you want a defined territory and a queue of warm leads, it isn't the right fit. If your instinct is to spar with a founder, the CTO, or the investor who can open an account, host the right 14 people for dinner, and follow up with an architecture sketch in 48 hours, keep reading.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Build**

* Run the executive programs. Create and run four to six events a month: executive dinners, co-hosted events with VCs, neoclouds, and NVIDIA, founder meetups, side events at GTC, NAB, CVPR, and IBC, hackathons, peer advocacy sessions, an executive advisory forum, and a CFO roundtable. Partner with the Dev-Rel team on events, especially founder-led ones.
* Own the executive message. Write the 30-second pitch, event content, follow-ups, and partner messaging that Backblaze executives use with AI builders. Work with Brand and Developer Relations so the story is consistent from the stage to the inbox.
* Work the investor channel. Build warm paths through Backblaze's board, investors, and the VCs, PE firms, and GPU lenders behind target accounts.
* Build with Solutions. Bring Solution Architects into account briefings, reference architectures, TCO, and proof-of-concept design. Run most early technical conversations yourself and hand deeper validation to Solutions.
* Map the influencers. Develop relationships with NVIDIA, neoclouds, data platforms, and performance-storage vendors such as Weka, VAST, DDN, and Hammerspace. Work with the Neocloud and Partnerships Leads to turn the strongest into the Phase 2 partner short list.
* Make advocacy repeatable. Align with our CS and Partner teams to sign 3 to 5 design partners and move them up the advocacy ladder: reference, case study, speaker, peer advocate, advisory forum. Work with Customer Success, Sales, and Operations so no customer is over-asked.
* Grow into the next phase. As the program matures, help build the partner motion and log inbound M&A and strategic-investment interest for the CEO, CRO, and CFO.

### **Own**

* Build and score the target list. Own 50 Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts across physical AI, generative AI media, and multimodal data providers. Use AI agents, CRM data, and market signals (funding rounds, GPU contracts, launches, key hires, expiring credits) to rank accounts by actionability every week.
* Map each account. Chart the buying group from head of infrastructure and data to the CEO, CTO, CPO, and CFO, plus the investors and partners who influence storage and compute decisions. Write a one-page brief for each priority account: problem hypothesis, likely architecture, value, and gaps. You will have a team of AI-based ABM and Target Accounts agents providing intelligence and signals.
* Pair executives. Match every priority account with a Backblaze executive sponsor by role: CEO to CEO, CFO to CFO, CTO to Solutions. Prepare them, track every touch, and keep each relationship moving.
* Hand off cleanly. Move an account to Sales when it has an executive relationship, a qualified problem, and a solution it has seen. Deliver the handoff brief, then stay on as executive sponsor and partner lead through close and expansion.
* Keep the program honest. Log executive touches, introductions, events, and pipeline adds in the CRM. Report results and learnings at the 90-day review and at each phase gate.

**What You Will Personally Build in the First Six Months**
----------------------------------------------------------

Build - but build with Solutions, Sales, Partners,

jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.

**WHO YOU ARE**

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks, we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

**S - Sharp**

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

**H - Hungry**

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

**A - Adaptable**

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

**R - Resilient**

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

**C - Curious**

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

### **Role Overview**

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sales outcomes for Zocks’ largest and most strategic customers which include large RIAs, broker-dealers, banks, and other financial services firms. You will act as a trusted advisor to these accounts, deeply integrating Zocks into their workflows and business processes to drive adoption, value and growth.

* Build and deepen relationships with senior stakeholders at our most strategic accounts

#### **Product Adoption and Utilization**

* Drive adoption and usage by customers following Zocks best practices and optimal patterns

#### **Value Realization**

* Define, communicate & measure Zocks ROI for the customer

#### **Partner cross-functionally**

### **Requirements**
