* Executive credibility: You can speak the language of senior stakeholders in financial services firms and have the presence to earn trust up and down the organization
* Excellent communication and strategic planning skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at various levels
* Results driven, with ability to ruthlessly prioritize competing tasks
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced high-growth environment, balancing strategic initiatives with hands-on day-to-day execution.
* High technical curiosity with willingness to learn product workflows and integrations
* Strong interest in AI and how it will transform wealth management and financial services

**BENEFITS**

The full picture

Health

Everything else

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**

jobs.title: Account Manager - Expansion

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Overview:**

As a Senior Account Manager, you will own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of Qolo's most strategic customers: large commercial banks that use Qolo to power virtual account management, connected deposits, embedded payments, and commercial card programs, and high-growth fintechs running payouts, B2B virtual card, and gift and incentive card programs on our platform. You will be accountable for recurring revenue, renewals, expansion bookings, and forecast accuracy across a multi-million-dollar book of business.

  

You will know each customer's business well enough to sit on their side of the ledger, and you will move every relationship from vendor toward strategic partner. You will be the person our customers call first, and the person our internal teams look to for a clear view of what each customer needs, what it is worth, and what happens next and you will own a strategic portfolio of strategic bank partners and fintech platform customers. Reporting to the SVP of Customer Success, you will partner closely with Product,Engineering, Production Support, Onboarding, Solutions Architecture, Finance, and Qolo leadership.

**Responsibilities:**  
  
**Customer intelligence and account strategy**

* Know each customer's core business, market size, go-to-market thesis, competitive position, and whether payments are critical, essential, or ancillary to their model.
* Track the metrics that matter to each customer, including revenue, growth rate, budgets, and internal goals, longside their usage and growth on Qolo.
* Understand each customer's top initiatives, how they fund and prioritize projects, and which teams carry weight, and position Qolo inside that story.
* Identify where Qolo can help unlock a customer's addressable market, and act as an advisor where Qolo is not the direct solution.

**Commercial ownership and revenue growth**

* Own Total Recurring Revenue for your assigned portfolio and track actuals against forecast every month.
* Identify, scope, and close expansion opportunities (new products, payment rails, card programs, ledger services, fraud, tokenization, and customer portal) that contribute to the Account Management team bookings target.
* Lead renewals, amendments, and pricing negotiations with a clear strategy and defined levers, including volume commitments and monthly minimums.
* Monitor contractual minimums and invoicing accuracy with Accounting, and raise revenue gaps early with a quantified recovery plan.

**Strategic bank partnership managemen**t

* Serve as the primary commercial lead for bank partners, coordinating across their product, operations, technology, procurement, and legal teams.
* Manage DaaS and development hour economics: track hour allocations, reconcile delivered versus billed work, and make sure scope, sizing, and cost are documented before work starts.
* Align each bank's roadmap with Qolo's roadmap and delivery capacity, separate committed dates from aspirational ones, and keep release schedules and release notes flowing on time.
* Help bank partners grow their own client pipelines on Qolo, from Quantum Ledger prospects to new commercial card launches.

**Engagement model and executive relationships**

* Build a multi-threaded engagement model for every account, pairing Qolo and customer counterparts at each level (executive, product, business, and operations) with recurring touchpoints and clear ownership.
* Run quarterly business reviews and roadmap sessions, and keep account plans and customer business profiles current every quarter.
* Map each customer on how they view Qolo, from vendor to partner, and act on the gaps that hold the relationship back.
* Develop referenceable customers and pursue testimonials, joint press releases, and co-marketing.
* Represent Qolo in customer onsites and at industry events such as Money20/20.

**Internal advocacy and cross-functional leadershi**p

* Be the voice of the customer with Product, Engineering, Production Support, Partner and Network Operations, and Risk and Compliance.
* Manage enhancement requests and issues, capturing the customer problem statement, revenue impact, scalability, and priority so the right work gets built.
* Participate in product prioritization and drive clear DRI and RACI ownership on cross-functional initiatives and escalations.
Partner with Onboarding Project Managers, Client Services, and Solutions Architects to launch expansions smoothly.  

  

**Operating rhythm and forecastin**g

* Maintain a clean HubSpot pipeline with defined milestones, risks, and recovery plans for every account.
* Deliver monthly scorecards and forecast updates with actionable insight, using data to anticipate customer needs before they impact results.
* Share customer trends and data that shape Qolo's product and business direction.

**How You Will Operate**

* Trusted advisor. You understand each customer's business model, strategy, and revenue drivers well enough to be seen as a strategic partner, not just a vendor contact, and you build partnerships where growth benefits both companies.
* Proactive owner. You shift from reactive account management to proactive leadership, anticipating needs and risks before they escalate.
* Commercially disciplined. You bring a revenue-first mindset to every conversation, put pricing, scope, and timelines
* in writing, protect Qolo's economics, and still find the path to yes for the customer.
* Clear communicator. You communicate clearly to bank executives, fintech founders, and engineers alike, and you choose clarity over comfort when the news is hard.
* Accountable. You follow and improve the processes that keep the team accountable, and you deliver accurate, professional work on or ahead of schedule.

**Requirements:**

* 10+ years in account management, client partnership, or enterprise sales in payments, banking, or fintech SaaS, including direct ownership of a multi-million-dollar book of business.
* Experience

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Location:** US (Remote); preference for candidates on Eastern Time

**Compensation:** $80,000 - $90,000 per year + Stock Options

##### **About Argyle**

Argyle is a fast-growing, remote-first, Series C startup solving a consumer data problem.

For decades, financial service providers and other businesses have collected and verified consumer income, employment, and asset data the same way: by hand or via verification databases. These methods are expensive, time consuming, high friction, and/or unreliable. In turn, experiences like applying for a loan or completing a background check are challenging for service providers and consumers alike.

The solution is Argyle. We’re the leading provider of direct-source, consumer-permissioned income, employment, and asset verifications. We make it fast and easy to gain secure and reliable access to the most complete real-time datasets stored in consumers’ payroll and banking accounts, so service providers can automate verification workflows, save time, reduce risks, lower costs, and build better product experiences.

Named one of America’s Best Startup Employers of 2026 by Forbes, Argyle largely serves the mortgage, government benefits, tenant screening, lending, and background check industries as well as the gig economy.

Founded in 2018, Argyle’s commitment to innovation is backed by investors including Bain Capital Ventures, Checkr, Mastercard, Rockefeller Asset Management and SignalFire.

##### **About the team**

Revenue Operations runs the critical business operations that keep Argyle’s sales motion moving fast, from deal approvals and contracting to billing, commissions, and the CRM. We’re a small team of experienced operators, and we lean heavily on automation and AI tools to do more with less.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who wants to learn from an experienced RevOps team and own real processes within a few months. You’ll work daily with account executives, customer success managers, marketing, and finance.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* **Be the first stop for RevOps requests.** Own the request queue for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Handle the routine work yourself, from contract amendments and exports to pricing reviews, SKU setup, and Salesforce cleanup. On every request, engage stakeholders and pressure-test their asks until you land on a solution or a clear escalation path.
* **Own monthly billing preparation.** Run most of the pre-invoice process each month, from custom billing processes, credits tracking, and discrepancies review to finalizing amounts each customer owes.
* **Build controls that scale.** Run recurring checks that signed contracts, billing setup, and platform access line up, and turn repeat requests into documented processes or automation, including AI-assisted workflows.
* **Handle routine deal desk approvals.** Review opportunities in Salesforce for completeness, pricing setup, and contract dates before approval, and resolve setup issues that slow deals down.
* **Manage the customer account lifecycle.** Handle activations, terminations, reinstatements, and access changes, and keep Salesforce and our billing platform in sync.
* **Keep CRM data clean.** Maintain accounts, contacts, ownership, and pipeline hygiene. Monitor the health of the HubSpot–Salesforce sync to ensure a smooth handoff from Marketing to Sales.
* **Support partner and government reporting.** Help prepare monthly and quarterly revenue share reports for channel and integration partners, plus recurring reporting on our government contracts.
* **Co-own sales commissions.** Learn our monthly commission process hands-on, then share ownership of running it each month, from calculating payouts to keeping the process accurate and on time.

##### **What Success Looks Like**

* **Month 1:** You’ve worked through a full billing cycle and the request queue alongside the team, and you’ve shadowed the monthly commissions process.
* **Month 2:** You own most of billing preparation and routine requests on your own, and you’ve used AI tools to automate your first repetitive steps.
* **Month 3:** You own all billing preparation, serve as the front line for the RevOps request queue, and co-own the monthly commission process.
* **Ongoing:** You’re the first response to GTM requests and resolve most of them yourself. You run the monthly pre-invoice process and own key communications between GTM and Finance throughout. With the time AI automation frees up, you spend more of your month on higher-level business analysis.

##### **What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years in revenue operations or sales operations, ideally at a B2B SaaS business
* Comfort working in Salesforce day to day, from building reports and updating records in bulk to troubleshooting validation rules
* Experience building reports in Looker or another BI tool, and turning that data into analyses that solve real business problems
* Strong spreadsheet skills, including lookups, pivots, and reconciling data across sources
* A high bar for accuracy and attention to detail, since you’ll work with the contract, billing, and commissions data behind our revenue
* Interest in using AI tools to automate repetitive work
* Clear written communication with internal teams and customers
* **Nice to have:** Salesforce Administrator certification; familiarity with HubSpot; exposure to mortgage, lending, or fintech

##### **Why Argyle?**

* **Remote-first.** Join a globally distributed team.
* **Strong teammates.** Work alongside smart, thoughtful, and ambitious people who genuinely care about delivering best-in-class service.
* **High standards, low ego.** We hold ourselves to a high bar and keep egos out of it.
* **Real ownership.** Everyone owns meaningful work and has the flexibility to work in a way that suits them.
* **Inclusive by design.** We’re intentional about building a team where different backgrounds and perspectives lead to better ideas and stronger collaboration.

new_jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
new_jobs.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including **NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit**—partner with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Role**

The **Strategy & Operations** team at Amae plays a critical role in driving the programs and systems that support delivery of excellent care. This highly cross-functional role will work across a diverse range of teams and functions, leveraging complex problem-solving skills in a growth-oriented organization. This role is located in San Francisco, in office 5 days a week.

**What You Will Work On**

* Own the creation, rollout, and ongoing refinement of projects that support day-to-day behavioral health delivery; build structured workflows, playbooks, and feedback loops
* Partner with clinical and operational leaders to identify bottlenecks and design solutions that scale across markets
* Use data, user feedback, and operational insights to evaluate program performance and identify improvement opportunities
* Drive alignment across clinical, operations, product, and leadership teams to ensure programs are implemented smoothly and sustainably
* Lead communication, training, and rollout plans for new initiatives

**What You'll Have**

* 3+ years of experience within private equity management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, or within a healthcare organization driving initiatives from ideation to implementation
* Scrappy, self-starter mindset who vigorously looks for ways to grow an early-stage company
* Proven experience structuring and leading projects to drive successful outcomes
* Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills with high proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience in a startup and/or entrepreneurial environment; ability to thrive in a fast-paced culture, growing 0–1
* Passion and interest for the mental health space
* Bachelor's Degree required

**What We're Building**

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
* Precision medicine for severe mental illness, using multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data to personalize treatment.
* A clinical operating system that integrates longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer.
* New science and measurement frameworks to define what real outcomes look like in SMI.
* A health-system partnership model proving coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. **Base salary range for this role is $125,000 to $165,000 per year** based on a full-time schedule; the compensation package will include equity. Total compensation includes comprehensive medical/dental/vision, unlimited PTO, parental leave, and programs built around employee well-being. We'll share specifics during the interview process.

*Amae Health is building the care platform, the precision medicine, and the frontier science that severe mental illness has never had. If you want to be part of creating something this hard and this important, something that has never been done, we'd like to talk.*

**What We Value**

* **We center care in all we do.** Empathy is not a brand value. It's how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
* **We challenge convention.** The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
* **We take the work seriously, not ourselves.** High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
* **Your job isn't done until the job is done.** We close gaps, we follow through, and we don't hide behind titles or org charts.
* **We win together and fail toge

You will architect complex operational workflows, drive complex, multi-quarter roadmaps and bring the technical fluency and business acumen needed to evaluate the viability and impact of technical solutions.

Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, CoreOps, you will operate with high autonomy to drive cross-functional execution and change management. You will provide strategic guidance, technical domain oversight, and peer mentorship to other individuals within the team, supporting them as individual product owners of their deliverables while elevating operational rigor across the team.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City, Austin, Palo Alto, or San Francisco for our hybrid working model.

### **What You'll Do**

* Drive RecTech Modernization & Tooling Strategy: Act as the primary liaison to HR Tech to distill TA vision into a cohesive technology roadmap. Oversee high-complexity initiatives, such as the deployment of our Offer-to-Hire workflow using AI and automation and pilots for enterprise-grade interview and debrief intelligence suites
* Architect Complex Workflows & Systems: Develop end-to-end process maps for all key recruiting workflows to identify friction points and structural opportunities. Architect major workflow redesigns, such as overhauling the end-to-end offer process to minimize manual interventions
* Optimize Greenhouse as a Core System of Work: Consolidate high-priority issue areas across the hiring lifecycle to eliminate fragmented, manual workflows. Leverage native Greenhouse features and strategic integrations to standardize processes, lower compliance risks, eliminate administrative overhead, and elevate data integrity
* Drive Cross-Functional Execution & Autonomy: Independently own and drive goals, steering change management and adoption across global teams for all systems and process updates. Resolve complex escalations, operating with autonomy while proactively flagging for support when necessary
* Mentor Junior Members of the Team: Act as a dedicated mentor and sounding board for the RecTech and Process Optimization sub-domain owners, supporting their development into strong Product Owners without having direct administrative or people management duties
* Leverage Data to Drive Strategic Outcomes: Proactively identify internal TA needs (recruiters, coordinators, hiring teams), act as a compelling communicator across cross-functional groups, and regularly leverage data diagnostics to drive operational outcomes

### **What You'll Bring**

* Advanced Expertise: 8+ years of experience architecting complex operational workflows, recruiting technology evaluations and implementations, and multi-quarter systems roadmaps
* Scope & Complexity: Proven track record of independently owning multi-faceted goals, driving cross-functional execution, and resolving complex operational escalations. Operates with high autonomy and demonstrates sound judgment on when to flag for escalation
* Commitment to Mentorship & Influence: Proactively identifies TA needs, acts as a compelling communicator across technical and non-technical stakeholders, and demonstrates a proven ability to mentor and uplevel junior team members
* Technical Aptitude & Tooling Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of core recruiting platforms (e.g., Greenhouse, Gem, Guide). Proven track record of evaluating tool ROI systematically, sunsetting redundant platforms, and experimenting with automations and AI in recruiting workflows
* Workflow Architecture & People Team Alignment: Demonstrated experience redesigning complex hiring workflows and partnering with downstream teams (HRIS, HR Operations, FP&A) to ensure cross-system alignment and data hygiene
* Hands-On Data Fluency: Comfortability extracting and diagnosing pipeline and operational data directly in Google Sheets using advanced formulas to run ad-hoc analyses and diagnose root causes

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Together, we change the world.

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Herbert Wertheim School of Optometry and Vision Science
  
  
Mission Statement Advancing optometric education, clinical practice, and vision research for the benefit of society. Vision Preeminence and leadership in optometric education, patient care, and vision science.
  
  
Values and Guiding Principles
  
  
At Berkeley Optometry and Vision Science, as part of a world-renowned university that embraces excellence and access, we foster an environment of trust and mutual respect, free expression and inquiry, and personal resilience and achievement. We demonstrate sensitivity and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds present in our community. These principles serve us daily in our reasoning and actions and aid us in our decision-making. new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Multidisciplinary Teams
new_jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Senior Program Manager, Multidisciplinary Teams (MDTs)

**Department:** Strategic Partnerships & Policy (SPP)

**Reports to:** Chief Policy Officer (CPO)

**Location:** 3450 Third Street, San Francisco, CA 94124

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**

Safe & Sound's mission is to prevent and reduce the impact of childhood abuse, neglect, and trauma. We do this by strengthening families, building communities, and advancing healing, equity, and justice. We envision a future free from childhood trauma, where all children, families, and communities are safe, supported, and loved.

Combining direct services, training and capacity building, research, and advocacy to strengthen families in their communities, address childhood trauma, and prevent abuse, Safe & Sound has evolved into a premiere child-serving organization, bringing over 50 years of service to our community.

We reach more than 11,000 caregivers and children annually with our unique coordinated, multi-generational approach that spans the entire spectrum of prevention and intervention to strengthen family resilience and address factors that put families at risk for experiencing abuse or involvement in unsubstantiated abuse allegations.

The organization has an annual operating budget of approximately $10.8 million and is supported by approximately 55 staff, interns, and more than 100 volunteers. Safe & Sound headquarters is located in a historic firehouse in the Haight-Ashbury neighborhood of San Francisco, with a second office in the Bayview neighborhood.

More information is available at: .

**OVERALL SUMMARY**

The Senior Program Manager (SPM), Multidisciplinary Teams (MDTs) provides strategic leadership for Safe & Sound’s role in San Francisco’s city-wide, multi-disciplinary teams that seek to advance system enhancement and improve the response to abused and exploited children. This is a leadership role, not a coordination role: the SPM sets direction, owns the data and the story it tells, leads the meetings, and drives the work forward between them, serving as a thought partner with agency partners and funders.

These teams include the Children’s Advocacy Center (CAC), the Working Group and Steering Committee for children and youth experiencing sexual exploitation (Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children, CSEC), the Child Death Review Team (CDRT), and the Family Violence Council (FVC).

The SPM, MDTs holds an important role in implementing the department’s strategic direction. The SPM will work with external stakeholders and community and public partners to:

(1) enhance the coordinated, multidisciplinary approach to investigating child abuse allegations and providing trauma-informed services for victims of child abuse and exploitation;

(2) develop policies, protocols, procedures, and other data-informed solutions to improve complex systems challenges in the child abuse response structure;

(3) reduce re-victimization and the devastating long-term effects of child abuse and exploitation on children, their families, and society;

(4) increase coordinated case planning and service delivery for victims; and

(5) turn the patterns and learnings that surface across the teams into recommendations for practice, policy, and prevention.

The ideal candidate is familiar with child abuse, commercial sexual exploitation of children, and/or other areas of family violence, and with government systems and public policy. The position requires excellent project management and facilitation skills; strong written and verbal communication; experience in relationship-building and stakeholder engagement; strong analytical and organizational abilities; and the independence and initiative to identify what needs to happen, propose a plan with dates, and carry it through without step-by-step direction.

The position is a supervisory role that reports to the Chief Policy Officer, supervises the MDT Coordinator, collaborates with other SPP staff, receives strategic direction from the partners of the multi-disciplinary teams, and works frequently with representatives from San Francisco child welfare, law enforcement, public health, and other public and community agencies responding to family violence.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Strategic Leadership and Thought Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Human Services Agency (HSA), other public funders, and partner agency leaders: learn what each partner needs from each team, bring ideas and options, and propose how the work can deliver more, rather than waiting for direction.
* Develop, with the CPO, a vision and annual priorities for each MDT, grounded in funder scopes of work, contract requirements, best practice, and partner input.
* Consolidate recommendations and patterns from the MDTs into actionable policy and practice changes that address barriers for children and youth interfacing with systems.
* Build structured learning into team meetings, such as reflection questions on what the group has learned and de-identified case briefs that partners can carry back to their leadership.
* Identify policy and legislative opportunities that emerge from MDT work and develop them with the CPO and the Senior Policy Advisor.

**Facilitation and Meeting Leadership**

* Own the agenda, preparation, facilitation (or co-facilitation where a partner agency facilitates), and follow-up for key MDT meetings and decision-making processes, so that Safe & Sound leads rather than supports.
* Establish and uphold group agreements so partners can examine what went wrong in a case or system without assigning blame.
* Disseminate information and materials, monitor logistics, and keep a running agenda and action-item tracker for each team.
* Ensure follow-up on action items so that team priorities move forward in a timely fashion.

**Family Violence Council, Data, and Research**

* Own Safe & Sound’s contribution to the Family Violence Council, including attending and preparing for council meeting

new_jobs.title: HR Generalist
new_jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**
-----------------

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who We Are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.  
Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.  
Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.  
Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an HR Generalist to own the operational backbone of People at Bobyard: payroll, benefits, leave, compliance, onboarding, offboarding, and HR systems. You will be our third Operations hire and second HR hire, reporting to our People lead and working closely with Finance, Talent, IT, and our outside vendors.

This is a hands-on role. You will run payroll, partner with vendors to register us in new states, support benefits, leave, and onboarding, and field the questions that land in our People inbox every day. You will also spot what is breaking as we grow and build the tracker, template, or workflow that fixes it.

You will thrive here if you love getting the details right, can juggle a lot of moving parts without dropping any, and bring warmth to every employee interaction while still holding clear boundaries.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Payroll and compensation operations**

* Process payroll across multiple schedules (bi-weekly and semi-monthly, global) in Rippling, including new hires, terminations, pay changes, commissions, and off-cycle runs.
* Review payroll for accuracy before approval and resolve employee pay questions.
* Partner with our outside accounting firm on payroll tax notices and state agency mail.

**Multi-state and international compliance**

* Partner with vendors to register Bobyard in new states as we hire there, and help keep our state accounts in good standing.
* Help maintain the employee handbook, state supplements, and required postings as laws change.
* Support wage and hour compliance, including exempt and non-exempt classification reviews.
* Manage I-9s, records retention, and audit-ready employee files.
* Track required training (harassment prevention, security awareness) and follow up until completion.

**Benefits and leave administration**

* Support benefits administration with our broker and providers, including enrollments, life events, and COBRA.
* Support open enrollment, from employee communications to post-enrollment audit.
* Support leaves of absence with our leave vendor, including state paid family leave claims and payroll top-up calculations.
* Be a friendly, plain-language answer to employee benefits and PTO questions.

**Onboarding and offboarding**

* Support the new hire experience from signed offer to Day 1: Rippling setup, paperwork, IT and equipment requests, calendars, and welcome communications, with a path to owning onboarding as you ramp.
* Help coordinate weekly start cohorts and their Day 1 and Week 1 schedules.
* Support offboarding, including final pay, benefits, access removal, equipment return, and required state notices.

**HR systems, data, and documents**

* Be our in-house Rippling expert: workflows, approvals, reporting, and clean employee data.
* Maintain the People team intake form and trackers, keeping requests moving and nothing dropped.
* Prepare employment change documents, such as offer, promotion, and change of status letters, for People lead approval.

**Vendors and special projects**

* Be a day-to-day contact for People vendors: payroll, benefits broker, 401(k), leave management, and immigration counsel.
* Support projects that keep a fast-growing company running, like address changes across agencies and policy rollouts.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Must haves**

* 3 to 5 years of HR generalist or People Ops experience, ideally at a venture-backed startup.
* Hands-on, multi-state payroll experience, including California.
* Working knowledge of US employment law: wage and hour, leaves, final pay, and classification.
* Comfort administering benefits and leaves end to end.
* Experience with Rippling or a comparable HRIS, and confidence in spreadsheets.
* Sharp attention to detail. You double check the numbers before they go out.
* Clear, warm writing, and the discretion to handle sensitive information.
* A bias for action. You see a gap, propose a fix, and ship it.

**Nice to haves**

* Experience working with vendors to register a company in new states, or supporting employees in another country.
* Commission payroll experience.
* Experience working with a leave management vendor.
* PHR, SHRM-CP, or a similar certification.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

* $100,000–$120,000 base + bonus + 0.01%–0.03% equity (4-year vest)
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!

Come build with us!

Compensation Range: $100K - $120K

*\*An internal or pre-identified candidate is currently under consideration, but all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.*

  

**Customer Organization Program Manager**

  

Join Epicor as a Program manager! The Customer Organization Program Manager owns the development of Epicor's FY27 sales plays from strategy to enablement. You will turn identified sales plays into playbooks, content and training that help sellers lead with business outcomes, not features.

  

You'll sit at the center of Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Generation. You'll build the programs and hand-offs that connect them, so every launch, campaign and training lands as one cohesive story for sellers and customers. This is a new role on a growing Revenue Enablement team, with the ability to influence how Epicor goes to market.

  

**What you will be doing**

  

**Own the sales plays**

  

* Build and maintain a playbook for each FY27 sales play: target personas (CFO, COO, CIO, CXO), verticals, discovery questions, value messages, proof points, objection handling and competitive positioning.

* Identify the content each play needs at each sales stage, audit what exists, and fill the gaps.

* Coordinate content development between Sales, Product Marketing and SMEs, managing timelines, owners and approvals.

* Coordinate rollout and training for each play alongside enablement lead, from launch sessions to manager coaching guides and reinforcement.

Run the rolling 2-quarter enablement roadmap with Product Marketing, so product launches are packaged into play-based training.  

  

**Strengthen the Marketing–Sales partnership**

  

* Design programs and clear hand-offs between Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales, from MQL to SAL through to Discovery.

* Act as stakeholder from Sales on Insight conference development and delivery.

* Align campaign messaging with sales plays so sellers can follow up on what marketing starts.

Set up feedback loops with sellers and sales leaders and bring field insight back to Marketing and Product.  

  

**Activate plays in market**

  

* Work with Marketing and regional sales leaders on market activation: campaigns, events, account-based programs and partner motions tied to each play.

* Work with enablement lead to select the right format for each audience and moment, such as live sessions, microlearning, play kits, battlecards, talk tracks, demo stories and digital sales rooms.

Write clear, compelling seller-facing communications for launches, play updates and program news.  

  

**Measure and improve**

  

* Define and report success measures for each play: adoption, content usage, pipeline created and win rate in the target segment.

Use the data to refine plays, retire content that isn't working, and prioritize what comes next.  

  

**Other enablement projects**

  

* Support broader Customer Organization strategic initiatives, including leader programs, sales kickoffs, onboarding and tools rollouts, and others as assigned.

Support with Chief of Staff duties as assigned.  

  

**What you will likely bring**

  

* 10+ years of experience across sales enablement, product or solution marketing, sales programs, or marketing communications in B2B technology. Experience in an ERP organization or similar complex SaaS is required.

* A track record of building sales plays, playbooks or go-to-market programs that sellers actually use.

* Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex product capabilities into clear business outcome and value messages.

* Program management discipline: you can run multiple workstreams, timelines and stakeholders at once and keep them on track.

* Experience influencing without authority across Sales, Marketing and Product, including with senior leaders.

* Comfort designing and delivering training, both live and virtual, to sales audiences.

* An analytical mindset, with experience using CRM and enablement data to measure impact.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

  

**What could set you apart**

  

* Background in communications or PR, especially message development, internal communications or change communications.

* Experience with ERP, supply chain or industry software sold to manufacturing, distribution, retail, automotive or building supply businesses.

* Familiarity with value selling, MEDDICC, Challenger or similar sales methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Highspot, Seismic or an LMS.

* Experience with account-based marketing, demand generation programs or partner enablement.

* Experience using AI tools to speed up content creation, research or enablement delivery.

Prior experience leading or mentoring others, or a desire to build a team.  

  

**What success looks like in your first year**

  

* **First 60 days:** Learn the four plays, sellers and stakeholders. Audit existing content against each play, and build first sales play.

* **By 6 months:** Launch complete playbooks for at least three plays, with training delivered to Account Executives/TMs and CAMs, and an agreed Marketing-to-Sales hand-off process.

* **By 12 months:** All four plays are live and refreshed quarterly. Fewer standalone feature trainings reach sellers, and play adoption and pipeline impact are reported to leadership each quarter.

**Own commercial execution**

**Partner deeply with Customer Success**

**How you'll ramp:**

...within your first week...

* Shadow your first expansion deal
* Learn about our product + customer segments
* Meet your colleagues on the CSM and AM team

...day 30...

* Get hands on with the product yourself
* Complete stakeholder maps and expansion hypotheses for top 25 accounts
* Establish operating cadence with CSMs; baseline your book (usage, adoption, renewal timing)
* Start building pipeline by week 3

...day 60...

* Consistent outbound motion underway

**What you've accomplished so far:**

* You are an excellent cross-functional partner: you thrive working with CS, Product, and leadership teams to move accounts forward
* You are comfortable leading “business value” and “ROI” conversations
* Willing to become a technical expert yourself without relying on a dedicated Solutions Engineer

**Why you should join:**

* You’ll be part of a fast-growing startup as it scales from 70 to 100 employees

At Prime Therapeutics (Prime), we are a different kind of PBM, with a purpose beyond profits and a unique ability to connect care for those we serve. Looking for a purpose-driven career? Come build the future of pharmacy with us.

**Job Posting Title**
---------------------

Business Analyst- REMOTE

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Business Analyst (BA) will execute on small projects as a liaison among business operations, technology groups, clients, business partners, vendors, and all project management offices to understand, analyze, and facilitate business needs, requirements, and impacts of business changes as a result of strategic initiatives, operational changes, compliance requirements, client needs, and technology or operational improvements.

**Responsibilities**

* Execute independently on small sized projects or as part of a team of BAs on larger projects working closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure superior customer and client experience
* Define and validate business needs with project team
* Participate in stakeholder analysis and identify subject matter experts needed for work effort
* Assess capability gaps, determine solution options and approach, and define solution scope
* Plan business analysis approach and activities
* Prepare for, conduct, and document elicitation sessions
* Manage requirements traceability to solution scope, objectives, system requirements, and testing
* Define user acceptance testing approach
* Adherence to business analysis discipline and standards in accordance with the Prime Project Lifecycle methodology
* Other duties as assigned

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, IT, or related area of study, or equivalent combination of education and/or relevant work experience; High School Diploma or GED equivalent required
* 3 years of work experience in business analysis

Must be eligible to work in the United States without the need for work visa or residency sponsorship

**Additional Qualifications**

* Intermediate understanding of business analysis concepts and methodologies
* Demonstrated drive to deliver results
* Demonstrated verbal, written communication, facilitation skills, conflict management, consensus building, problem solving, analytical skills, and creative thinking skills
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks with high degree of attention to detail
* Self-directed and strong personal initiative and accountability
* Team player, comfortable with fast paced, changing environment and ambiguity
* Experience in leading and motivating diverse project teams to achieve stated results
* Ability to independently deliver against all job accountabilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Functional knowledge of the Business Analysis Body of Knowledge (BABOK)
* Experience in client relationship management
* Working towards or has completed a Business Analysis certification
* Demonstrated experience in eliciting requirements using a variety of techniques
* Demonstrated experience in specifying and modeling requirements
* Proficient in basic office productivity software and tools (MS Word, Excel, Visio, etc.)

Every employee must understand, comply with and attest to the security responsibilities and security controls unique to their job, and comply with all applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements and internal policies and procedures

Every employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the job and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship. In addition, Prime retains the right to change or assign other duties to this job.

Potential pay for this position ranges from $66,000.00 - $106,000.00 based on experience and skills.

*Prime Therapeutics LLC is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We encourage diverse candidates to apply, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to* *race, color, religion, gender, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected class under federal, state, or local law.*

*We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives including qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records and any qualified applicants requiring reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law.*

*Prime Therapeutics LLC is a Tobacco-Free Workplace employer.*

Positions will be posted for a minimum of five consecutive workdays.
